title: cymbopogon strictus
intro: Cymbopogon strictus, commonly known as East Indian lemon grass, is a type of tropical grass native to India and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in East Indian lemon grass include essential oils like citral and geraniol, which have been found to possess antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions.
